name: Giant Eagle
languages: understands Common and Auran but can't speak them

traits.name: Keen Sight
traits.description: The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The eagle makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

description: Giant eagles are noble, intelligent birds of prey that nest on remote mountaintops, sometimes allying with good-hearted travelers against the forces of evil.
